## 实践与诊断（primary）

- [equals、hashCode 与 toString 直接契约](../../book/volume-02-java-objects/chapters/ch.java-oop.object-contracts.md) — `ch.java-oop.object-contracts#build` · `primary` · 为不可变 DeviceId 实现 equals/hashCode/toString，构造自反、对称、传递、相等哈希和脱敏输出断言，并生成记录输入、操作与结果的验证报告
- [equals、hashCode 与 toString 直接契约](../../book/volume-02-java-objects/chapters/ch.java-oop.object-contracts.md) — `ch.java-oop.object-contracts#diagnose` · `primary` · 注入 equals 比较字段与 hashCode 字段不一致、toString 泄露敏感值，定位契约失败并修复，并把异常定位到第一处可信证据
- [泛型、类型参数、边界与通配符](../../book/volume-03-java-engineering/chapters/ch.java-engineering.generics-type-safety.md) — `ch.java-engineering.generics-type-safety#build` · `primary` · 实现泛型 Result<T> 与 copy(List<? extends T>, List<? super T>)，用编译通过/失败片段证明读写边界，并生成记录输入、操作与结果的验证报告
- [泛型、类型参数、边界与通配符](../../book/volume-03-java-engineering/chapters/ch.java-engineering.generics-type-safety.md) — `ch.java-engineering.generics-type-safety#diagnose` · `primary` · 注入 raw type、错误通配符方向和不安全强转，依据编译警告或 ClassCastException 消除类型漏洞
- [List、Queue、Deque 与迭代](../../book/volume-03-java-engineering/chapters/ch.java-engineering.sequential-collections.md) — `ch.java-engineering.sequential-collections#build` · `primary` · 用 List 保存工单顺序、Queue 调度待处理项、Deque 实现撤销栈，并比较可变与不可修改视图
- [List、Queue、Deque 与迭代](../../book/volume-03-java-engineering/chapters/ch.java-engineering.sequential-collections.md) — `ch.java-engineering.sequential-collections#diagnose` · `primary` · 注入遍历时结构修改、空队列错误读取和把 Queue 当随机访问列表，定位异常/复杂度后修复
- [Set、Map、键相等性与哈希契约](../../book/volume-03-java-engineering/chapters/ch.java-engineering.associative-collections.md) — `ch.java-engineering.associative-collections#build` · `primary` · 完成该章的独立构建任务：从保序 List 输入构造 Set 去重 DeviceId、Map 统计类别数量，比较三者顺序/重复/键语义并证明 equals/hashCode 契约
- [Set、Map、键相等性与哈希契约](../../book/volume-03-java-engineering/chapters/ch.java-engineering.associative-collections.md) — `ch.java-engineering.associative-collections#diagnose` · `primary` · 注入误用 List 查重、可变字段参与 hash、只覆写 equals 和把 null/缺失混同，复现成本或查找失败后修复，并把异常定位到第一处可信证据
- [Comparable、Comparator 与稳定排序](../../book/volume-03-java-engineering/chapters/ch.java-engineering.sorting-comparators.md) — `ch.java-engineering.sorting-comparators#build` · `primary` · 为工单定义优先级降序、创建时间升序、ID 兜底的 Comparator 链，并验证稳定排序与 null 策略
- [Comparable、Comparator 与稳定排序](../../book/volume-03-java-engineering/chapters/ch.java-engineering.sorting-comparators.md) — `ch.java-engineering.sorting-comparators#diagnose` · `primary` · 注入比较器不满足反对称/传递或用减法溢出，构造三元素反例并改用安全比较方法，并把异常定位到第一处可信证据
- [复杂度、搜索、排序与基础数据结构选择](../../book/volume-03-java-engineering/chapters/ch.java-engineering.complexity-algorithms.md) — `ch.java-engineering.complexity-algorithms#build` · `primary` · 完成该章的独立构建任务：为 10²/10⁴/10⁶ 条工单比较线性查找、排序后二分、HashMap 查找的操作次数与内存取舍
- [复杂度、搜索、排序与基础数据结构选择](../../book/volume-03-java-engineering/chapters/ch.java-engineering.complexity-algorithms.md) — `ch.java-engineering.complexity-algorithms#diagnose` · `primary` · 从嵌套扫描和每次查询重复排序的实现中定位复杂度热点，替换结构后用规模曲线复核
